trust_decision.summary: Ownership of the BYPARAM selector strings (byparam.prop.param/value) parsed from a client PATCH-ACTION parameter in VPATCH property updates: they must be freed once per patch property, after the inner match loop. At the pinned commit this is ALREADY correct (free moved outside the loop), so there is no open flaw to fix.

landing_point.why: apply_property_updates is the only code handling PATCH-ACTION BYPARAM@ selectors; the advisory names VPATCH BYPARAM directly.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Not applicable: the vulnerability is already fixed at the pinned commit; the listed fix commits only bump docsrc/conf.py version strings (fix.diff:13-17, fix.diff:63-67, fix.diff:113-117).

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: BYPARAM selector reused to match/delete every same-kind property in one PATCH (multi-property delete must keep working)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: apply_param_match also consumes match_criteria_t from patch-target path segments (imap/ical_support.c:1572); a reverted per-iteration free there would be a sibling
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same union and same reuse-across-loop ownership pattern; but this would be a planted where-type sibling in an already-fixed tree.

O9_family: memory safety: double free (CWE-415) of parsed selector strings in VPATCH property loop

O10_build.toolchain: autotools + gcc, libical, cyrus-sasl, jansson, etc.
O10_build.project_tests: cassandane (Perl) CalDAV/VPATCH tests; not checked at pinned commit

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Move free(byparam.prop.*) out of the inner property loop (already done at the pinned commit, imap/ical_support.c:1795-1798).

out_of_scope_notes: Candidate is mis-mapped: the real source fix is commit b604666b9 'ical_support.c: fix VPATCH BYPARAM selector double-free', an ancestor of the pinned commit; the pinned commit itself is the 3.8.8 release-notes commit, which already lists CVE-2026-61915 (docsrc/imap/download/release-notes/3.8/x/3.8.8.rst:68-73).
If re-screened, pin to the parent of b604666b9 (and note a6a41c0fc / 62198c1bd also touch ical_support.c patch handling just before it).
